relations.description: Feed order must not change the two-vessel material state.
Feed order must not change separated elemental totals.
All selected elemental totals must scale by three.
Equivalent retained-water fractions must produce the same final inventory.
Partitioning evaporation must preserve the final material state.
Fourfold input scale must give fourfold elemental totals.
Receiver creation order must not affect dissolved-solute transfer.
Solvent dilution must not alter supplied silver or chlorine totals.
Evaporation depth must not alter sodium or chlorine totals.
Soluble feed order must not affect the filtered state.
The complete separation path must scale by two.
Removing water from one output must preserve combined non-hydrogen and non-oxygen totals.
